coverage_note: 03:31-03:45 opening Medi lines are engine garble (مهمتي / يا مهمني بابا جان من ميرم بيته سريع / يومي كان مني) - not judged. 04:19 Amal 'جان ملت' garbled. 36:57-42:30 a long stretch is Latin-transliterated with ‹› marks (bindir balna, nakun ahel, fa'il, ism). 32:07 engine wrote مناسبة where he most likely said معصبة (Amal: Perfect). 32:27 'بس بتها' = his stumbling attempt at ببسطها (pronunciation/word-finding, S4/S5, not written). 55:36 'بكرى' likely بقرا (engine). 07:45-08:04 تلاتة ونص -> اثنتين ونص is a factual time fix, not language. 50:18 'كان مرة؟' = kaman marra. Echo: 19:07 'Uh-huh.' after her 'احكي لي-' is real English backchannel, no Arabic hidden. Medi turn count is a grep of Medi lines containing Arabic script or ‹› Latin-Arabic (some English lines with ؟ included).

rows.why: Past tense for 'we' needs the -na ending; he said بدأ and she recast بدأنا, which he then used.

rows.medi_said: بدأنا a marketing project who who لازم اشتغلت كتير
rows.why: 'I had to work a lot' is kaan laazem + bare present; he put a past verb after laazem with no kaan; she recast and he repeated it.
rows.english: we started a marketing project where I had to work a lot

rows.why: The set reply to يعطيك العافية is الله يعافيك (he uses it at 59:42); he gave the reply for good-luck wishes and she moved on to مبروك.
Clock time takes el- (el-tmaanye); she let it pass and asked what he drank.
مغني is singer, not cloudy; she supplied مغيم and then said 'مغني is singer'.
Subject is الجو (masc) and she had just said مغيم; he made it feminine and she said حلو (could be read as الدنيا مغيمة, so low).
Idafa: the owner word takes el- (and he first tried الدرجة on the first word); she recast درجة الحرارة and he used it.
He said 18 for 80 (Fahrenheit); her questioning echo تمنتاش؟ made him change it to تمانين.
Approximately is حوالي; حوالين means around/surrounding; she only reacted to the number.

rows.medi_said: الـ Google Meet، بقدر، understand. بقدر، آ-آآآ، تفهم-
rows.why: Subject is Google Meet (it/he); she recast يفهم and he continued with يفهم.
بقدر is 'I can'; for Google Meet it is بيقدر; she only fixed the second verb.

rows.medi_said: يفهم عربي، بس ما، آآآم، م-م-ما، ما يقدر أكتب عربي.
rows.why: Plain present needs b-: ما بيقدر; passed.
The subject is still Google Meet, so 'it writes' = يكتب, not أكتب (I write); passed.

rows.medi_said: هو راح، يأتي، راح ي-يأ-- ي-يأتينا-
rows.why: يأتي is Fusha 'come'; spoken Levantine would be يجي / يعطينا; she only echoed it.
rows.english: it will give us the translation

rows.amal_said: تاني، تاني مشكلة or المشكلة التانية
rows.why: She explained 'second goes after' and gave المشكلة التانية (or تاني مشكلة without el-); he repeated المشكلة التانية.

rows.medi_said: إنه احنا، نكتب في، Arabic or English letters.
rows.why: enno keeps the b-: إنه احنا بنكتب; passed.
rows.english: that we write in Arabic or English letters

rows.why: Non-human plural takes a feminine adjective (حروف إنجليزية); she said مم-هم.

rows.medi_said: أنا ما بـ-- ما، ما بتذكر، هذي الكلمة.
rows.amal_said: فترة means while, a while or period of time.
rows.why: He said he does not remember فترة; she supplied the meaning (didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: So what, what makes you sad at this time?
rows.why: He read تعب as sad; she kept prompting and said 'Tired', he took it ('made you tired').
rows.english: what tires you most these days

rows.medi_said: هو، هما ما، ما، ما يخلصوا.
rows.right: ما بيخلصوا (my reading; he says it himself at 22:48)
rows.why: Plain present habit needs b-; she echoed يخلصوا without fixing.
He means every day (keeps asking them); kul + el- = all day; she answered only the preposition question.
rows.english: and every day I have to ask them

rows.medi_said: أنا بتعب كتير لما عيلتنا-- عيلتي، اللي، أشتغل معهم.
rows.why: After illi the present verb keeps b- (بشتغل); she let it pass.
rows.english: my family that I work with

rows.why: He means his family members (they); she recast هما and he used it.
He used the verb 'I worked' as the noun 'their work'; she gave شغلهم and he repeated it.
طلب takes من for the person asked; she had taught أطلب منهم at 20:48 and supplied منهم again.

rows.medi_said: أطلب منهم كتير إنو، يخلص، يخلصهم؟
rows.why: They finish it (the work): plural -u plus object -h; he said يخلص / يخلصهم and she gave يخلصوه.
زمان is 'long ago / old times'; for a long time she gave لوقت طويل and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: خطيبتي ما، ما بتضل- ... بتضل تعصب
rows.amal_said: خطيبتي ما بتضل تعصب. Here... you say, "My fiancée doesn't stay angry." So it's angry, not to get angry. It's the adjective.
rows.why: After ضل you need the state word (participle معصبة), not the verb تعصب; she named it ('it's the adjective') and he changed to معصب(ة).

rows.medi_said: it's أنا بـ بنزبط. Is it b- بنزبطها؟
rows.why: He reached for زبط (fix / work out) to mean make her happy; she gave ببسطها and said 'we did a lot' (known word).

rows.medi_said: أنا أعمل، ب- أ- أ- أعمل؟ بـ... أعمل. أعمل غلط.
rows.amal_said: أنا, I did something wrong. What's I made-
rows.why: He used present أعمل for 'I did'; she prompted 'I did / I made' and confirmed عملت; he said أنا عملت إشي غلط.
Subject is his fiancée, so feminine معصبة; she recast and he repeated.
I apologize is بتأسف (t- form); she said 'very close' and gave بتأسف, which he then used.

rows.medi_said: لما أنا، لما أنا بأعمل غلط، إشي غلط.
rows.why: lamma drops the b-; she let بأعمل pass.
He is talking about his fiancée (she), not 'you'; she said هي and he said 'هي, sorry'.
A long time is وقت طويل, not 'much time'; she said لا and he repeated وقت طويل.

rows.medi_said: شو، شو أكتر بقدر، شو أكتر بقدر أعمل؟
rows.amal_said: ولا إشي. خلاص، زي ما بدك.
rows.why: 'What else / what more can I do' is شو كمان; أكتر is the comparative 'more'; she answered without fixing.

rows.amal_said: بنطلع؟ ... Yeah, we say we take care of. ... ‹bindir balna›... ‹Ala›.
rows.why: He used 'look at' for babysitting his nieces; she queried بنطلع؟ and gave bindir balna 3ala, which he used.

rows.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?
rows.amal_said: Oh, here ‹hala ma btihtaj min›. ‹Bin khaf nakun›.
rows.why: khaaf takes min before a noun, but before a verb no min; she said 'here you don't need min' and he said bin khaf nikun.
Name/noun is ism; he added an ending, she recast and he repeated ism.

rows.medi_said: إحنا، إحنا بنخ-- بنخط. Ben-- it's just بنخط، right?
rows.why: The verb is خطط (doubled); he cut it to بنخط and she gave بنخطط, which he repeated.
'We' plan to be parents, so نكون not يكونوا; she recast and he settled on نكون.

rows.medi_said: على كلٍ. على كلٍ شو، اه، شو، اه، بعصب، بعصب.
rows.amal_said: اه. بس، اه، let's not use it I think. بلاش. Sounds wrong. ... you would say بشكل عام.
rows.why: He used على كل (anyway) for 'in general'; once he used it she said it sounds wrong and gave بشكل عام.
rows.english: in general, what makes me angry

rows.why: 3ashaan drops the b-; she recast أعصب and he asked 'عشان gets rid of be?' and she confirmed.

rows.medi_said: ولا إشي، ولا إشي بيعص-- بعصبني
rows.why: Subject is ولا إشي (it), so بيعصبني not بعصبني (I anger me); she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: She doesn't get-- هي ما، ما تعصب
rows.why: Plain present needs b-; she recast بتعصب and he said هي ما بتعصب.

rows.medi_said: هي ما بتعصب، آآآه، سهل كمان
rows.why: سهل is the adjective 'easy', not an adverb for how she gets upset; she rephrased in English 'quickly' and he said بسرعة.
rows.english: she doesn't get angry easily either

rows.amal_said: Well, that's not the same meaning. هذا مش نفس المعنى بالعربي ... a good word for this would be رايق
rows.why: He used the Farsi sense (calm); in Arabic مظلوم is oppressed; she said it's not the same meaning and gave رايق / رايقين.

rows.medi_said: لما أنا لما أزآن. ... أز، أزأل.
rows.why: He mangled زهقان into أزآن / أزأل; she said No twice and gave زهآن, then the verb أزهأ.

rows.medi_said: زهآن. زهآن. بس، آه، لما بزهأ.
rows.why: lamma drops the b-; she recast لما أزهأ and he repeated it.
Answer to 'what do you do when bored' is a plain present, so b-: بغير; she recast and he said بغير.
The set phrase is بغير جو with no el-; she recast بغير جو, he said بغير الجو again, and she said 'No ال. Just جو'.

rows.medi_said: أنا بظن إنه، عملنا كتير. عملنا-
rows.why: عمل needs what was done; she asked شو عملنا؟ twice until he said عملنا تمرين كتير.
rows.english: I think we did a lot (of practice)

rows.why: 'A lot of exercises' would be plural تمارين; she moved on with عنجد؟.
rows.english: we did a lot of exercises

rows.medi_said: So it has to be, has to be، اه، issue can، اه، can issue-
rows.amal_said: ما في can. It's it. ... لازم يكون issue، issue سيء.
rows.why: He asked how to say 'it has to be' and she supplied لازم يكون (didn't-know).
rows.english: it has to be a really bad issue
